cards.meaning: sluggish, slow (of sales, trade, business — goods on offer but few buyers)
cards.example: Matumal ang benta sa Divisoria kahit malapit na ang Pasko, kasi mahal ang bilihin.
cards.exampleMeaning: Sales in Divisoria are sluggish even though Christmas is near, because prices are high.
cards.note: Galing sa wika ng palengke at tindahan ('ang tumal ngayon'); ginagamit na rin sa balitang pang-ekonomiya. Iba sa 'mahina' (pangkalahatan); laging tungkol sa galaw ng benta. Kabaligtaran: 'mabenta', 'mabili'.
cards.tiesTo: PH 9-month growth 2.5%; Marcos orders GDP target review

cards.example: Tumaas ang disempleyo noong Setyembre, kahit dumami ang naghahanap ng trabaho.
cards.exampleMeaning: Unemployment rose in September, even as more people looked for work.
cards.note: Mula sa Kastila 'desempleo'. Pormal: 'antas ng disempleyo' sa PSA at mga ulat. Sa usapan: 'walang trabaho'. Iba ang 'kakulangan sa trabaho' (may trabaho pero kulang ang oras o kita).

cards.meaning: to some extent; somewhat (formal hedge before a 2-syllable verb)
cards.example: 今年的零售销售有所增长，但是力度不大。
cards.examplePinyin: Jīnnián de língshòu xiāoshòu yǒusuǒ zēngzhǎng, dànshì lìdù bú dà.
cards.exampleMeaning: Retail sales grew somewhat this year, but not with much strength.
cards.note: 书面语(央行声明、统计公报、研报)。搭配:有所+双音节动词——有所增长/下降/回升/改善/缓解。口语用'有点'/'稍微'(接形容词)。Official hedge: improved, but not by much.

cards.meaning: slow to happen; long delayed (with frustrated expectation)
cards.example: 房价迟迟没有企稳，家庭还是不敢花钱。
cards.examplePinyin: Fángjià chíchí méiyǒu qǐwěn, jiātíng háishi bù gǎn huā qián.
cards.exampleMeaning: Home prices have been slow to stabilise, so households still don't dare to spend.
cards.note: 副词,书面与正式口语皆可。搭配:迟迟不/迟迟没有/迟迟未能+动词(迟迟没有回暖、迟迟不肯表态、迟迟未能落地)。近义:'一直'中性;'始终'更正式、无不耐烦意味;迟迟 adds 'should have happened by now'.
cards.tiesTo: China consumption slow to recover; resale home prices -6.72% y/y
